module: "Garbage Debug" window (fg_garbage) of the Flowgraph editor: analyzes memory allocation (garbage) per graph and per node of a project after execution, from mgr.garbageData. It computes total, average per active frame, maximum, quantiles (25/50/75/90 %), number of active frames, sorts according to the flowgraph.debug.garbageSort preference and plots curves. Displays "Info only shows after running." as long as there is no data.
notes: Quantile statistics are only computed if there are more than 10 history entries.
The unit is "Bytes" except for activeCount ("Frames").

init.desc: Registers the window and prepares a color palette by magnitude (20 levels).

computeStats.desc: Completes and computes the statistics of an entry (histories, average, quantiles, min/max, activity percentage).

entry.desc: garbageData entry (graph, node or sum) with history, totalHistory, total.

setSortingValue.desc: Sets entry.value (according to the current sort key) and its magnitude as a power of 2.

computeAllStats.desc: Computes once the stats of all graphs/nodes and their sum, then sorts them by descending value.

drawStats.desc: Draws the statistics block and curves of an entry; skips entries with no value or inactive.

handleMeta.desc: Displays a "View Node" or "View Graph" button that selects and centers the element.

draw.desc: Draws the window: Debug Garbage checkbox, sort, whole project, graphs then nodes.
